title: Experts disagree on runtime/claude-plugin/mod
context:
Chief architect: Ruling, not a real disagreement: both seats want the mod to render one headline computed in src/hud. Recommending the snapshot-data wording because it also pins the package boundary (no new import from src into the plugin bundle). Accept as recommended.

Target: runtime/claude-plugin/mod
- solution-architect: the plugin mod imports nothing from src today, so sharing the gate catalog and headline must happen through snapshot data, not a new import across the package boundary that would change the plugin bundle
- application-architect: the mod only renders fields the snapshot already carries; desktopHeadline and buildBandView in model.ts stop deriving their own headline and read the one computed by computeHudHeadline in src/hud/snapshot.ts
